brief.title: Large Language Models in Medicine: Opportunities, Risks, and the Path Forward
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive review of how large language models are transforming clinical practice, medical research, and healthcare delivery — along with the critical challenges that must be addressed.
brief.goal: Viewers should understand the key capabilities of LLMs in medicine, recognize the major risks and limitations, and appreciate the framework needed for responsible clinical deployment.

sections.title: What Are LLMs and Why Do They Matter for Medicine?
sections.objective: Introduce large language models and contextualize their rapid emergence in healthcare applications.

sections.title: Key Clinical and Research Applications
sections.objective: Highlight the most promising use cases including clinical documentation, diagnostic support, patient communication, and medical education.

sections.title: Performance Benchmarks and Evidence
sections.objective: Present quantitative evidence on LLM performance in medical examinations and clinical reasoning tasks.

sections.title: Risks, Limitations, and Ethical Concerns
sections.objective: Outline the major challenges including hallucinations, bias, privacy, and lack of clinical validation.

sections.title: A Framework for Responsible Deployment
sections.objective: Summarize recommendations for integrating LLMs safely into clinical workflows.
